study.question: Can source-aligned coordinate15 deletion in only the advertisement-ID group or only item-attribute fields preserve source click quality at lower measured cost, and which group or interaction accounts for the uniform15 tradeoff?
study.hypothesis: Observation: source g2-r0004-context_only AUC0.660646940486458 uses32060453 parameters and measured model p50=11.726ms. The latest full16 replay matches that AUC (p50=11.761ms); uniform prefix15 g1-r0019-drop15_replay gives0.6605886110435017 (loss0.0000583294429563),30536464 parameters and p50=9.581ms. Removing coordinate0 instead gives0.6601641008760506; removing both endpoints gives0.6601860848903449, so effects are not monotone in width or position. Mechanism hypothesis: coordinate15 deletion across all item fields mixes advertisement-ID and attribute contributions; its small net effect may conceal a useful coordinate in one group offset by removal elsewhere. A mixed-width native model with common full16 scratch initialization can isolate those contributions while retaining actual sparse/dense savings. Previous severe native reductions favored ID16/attribute8 (0.6596593) over ID8/attribute16 (0.6582329), but they confound initialization and cannot dictate the new result. Primary selection and factorial contrasts use full validation click AUC, not four-task mean. Report continuous paired deltas to full16, uniform15 and baseline-din, all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, and sample/positive/negative counts. As a prospective exploratory screen, absolute source click-AUC loss <=0.0002 with fewer persistent parameters and lower measured model p50/p95 latency is considered a near-retention lead; this tolerance is a research choice informed by prior data, not a statistical noninferiority margin or user deployment requirement. Exact equality/negative deltas remain visible. No significance claim without independent seeds and permitted clustered uncertainty.

No original-paper reproduction or priority claim; novelty remains unverified.
Mirror native ordered shared-table ownership, per-field embedding_dim and reset order without editing host metadata, inputs, recipes or scores.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 ID-width(15/16) by item-attribute-width(15/16) deletion factorial. Only public field name item_id defines the advertisement-ID group; all other supplied source=item nonmeta fields are attributes. Each group retains prefix coordinates0..width-1. Generalize local alias-aware metadata layout and field-specific source-column/table copying. Expose four standalone modules with literal CONFIG: candidate.py=id15_attr16, attribute15.py=id16_attr15, uniform15_control.py=uniform15_replay, full16_control.py=full16_replay. Predicted persistent total/embedding/dense counts, derived from prior group contrasts and uniform15 receipts: id15_attr16=31212361/30946404/265957; id16_attr15=31384556/31123719/260837; uniform15=30536464/30276907/259557; full16=32060453/31793216/267237. Host must verify actual aliases/counts; these are predictions, not new measurements. Host gates before scientific interpretation: full16 must match unchanged g2-r0004-context_only initial parameters/buffers/predictions and ending CPU RNG at identical incoming state; uniform15 must match g1-r0019-drop15_replay state and operator. Device RNG and host example order must remain identical. For each mixed cell audit exact prefix table copies by field; semantic query/key/difference/product/action and target/pooled column copies; unchanged context/action/hidden/bias/Dice buffers; local FeatureMap nonmutation, actual table alias identity, padding, registered persistent parameter counts and absence of registered scratch state. Require finite four-task forward/default BCE/backward, empty/padded/masked-history tests, target-action invariance, correct auxiliary gradient blocks and allowed context gradient, primary-only persistent scorer Dice updates. A failed gate is an implementation failure, not scientific counterevidence; preserve costs and correct before dependent interpretation. Measure persistent/trainable total/embedding/dense counts, construction CPU time and peak memory, allocated GPU seconds, train wall/time/examples and peak GPU bytes, model-only whole-batch p50/p95 and throughput at8192, and loader-inclusive inference wall. History bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 already exist and remain exploratory, with N/positive/negative counts; report insufficient slices. Hour/composition/frequency/missing-field slices and paired user-cluster bootstrap require an authorized host interface supplying the necessary metadata/predictions; none is exposed here. Do not invent timestamps, raw IDs, frequencies or independent-sample confidence intervals. No raw data/checkpoints/GPU/tensor runtime or scoring interface is available locally. predictions: At least one mixed cell should retain source click AUC more closely than the uniform15 cell if group-specific cancellation explains its net effect; no sign or significance is assumed. Provisional ID16/attribute15 preference from severe-width history is weak and explicitly initialization-confounded.

Both mixed cells have fewer parameters than full16 and more than uniform15; native interaction widths decrease without expansion maps. Measured inference savings may be smaller or absent due to kernel shape effects.
Full16 and uniform15 concurrent controls reproduce prior fixed-seed AUCs within host numerical reproducibility; this validates implementation consistency, not generalization or repetition.
The factorial interaction is reported whether positive, null or negative; it concerns this fixed-seed training intervention and does not establish semantic-group importance at equal capacity.
falsifiers: Failed state/RNG/operator/masking or gradient gates invalidate the comparison; a successful training status alone is insufficient evidence of parity.

Neither mixed cell improves the source-relative quality/cost frontier, or either has no measured inference saving despite reduced parameter count: the proposed practical allocation benefit is unsupported in this range.
Mixed deletions yield additive similar losses with negligible interaction: the cancellation/interaction explanation is unsupported even if a smaller model remains a useful tradeoff.
Later authorized paired seeds show loss beyond the research screen or reverse group ordering: robust retention/group conclusions fail. They cannot be replaced by repeated identical-seed replays.
alternative_explanations: Review of trajectories: naive embedding/dense halving, table/interaction changes, learned/frozen expansion, context/item splits and native ID/attribute reductions did not recover the source; exact source-coupled initialization subsequently reduced the item8 loss and brought item14/15 much closer. Item12 was worse than item8 or14, and prefix/suffix/interior comparisons are nonmonotone. Thus source-coordinate alignment and one-pass optimization plausibly explain near-retention without any intrinsically redundant field group. Failed or abandoned directions remain evidence, not erased counterexamples.

Latest knowledge-usage review: prior declared DIN use produced the executed endpoint-deletion cells; interior14 and endpoint controls support fixed-seed sensitivity and a small factorial interaction, not a DIN-derived efficiency guarantee. All current industry use is scoped to provenance and the discriminating group-capacity test.

Training trajectory, sparse update statistics and Dice running-state changes can explain AUC differences despite shared retained initial tensors; exact full16 parity does not guarantee mixed-width equivalence.

Parameter differences, hardware alignment and loader timing can explain apparent group efficiency; no capacity-matched semantic-importance claim or extrapolation to production point-in-time visibility.
Auxiliary labels use user/category/brand24h matching; source click quality is not proof of advertisement-specific conversion quality. All auxiliary outcomes must remain visible.
